TASK:
Qualify frozen Qwen forwards and complete shard budgets. Deliver results/experiment_9155_v780_logit_runtime.json. Implement scripts/experiments/experiment_9155_v780_logit_runtime.py using the existing library paths. MODEL_SPECS: [{{"hf_id": "unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF", "quantization": "Q4_K_M"}}]. Requested inference_substrate_class: model_load_no_generation.
Use frozen unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF through the embedded tokenizer and supported full-vocabulary forward path. This task does not generate tokens. The load/forward class has a 2-second floor. A later small-token canary requires model_bounded_generation (10s); real generative work requires model_full_generation (60s). Never relabel or pad a run to pass.

The V780 continuation changes validation cost accounting and execution partition size only. Keep original historical authority and scientific thresholds. All model runs use frozen unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF; no generator weight updates.

1. Emit a flushed progress line at each phase boundary. Emit before and after every model load, generation, benchmark and subprocess that can take minutes. Print progress inside long loops. Supervise blocking calls with flushed heartbeats every 60 seconds. Keep every silence gap below 600 seconds. Write any file over about 200 lines in several tool calls of at most 200 lines. Send a progress message between writing calls. Never use one huge tool call.
2. PRECONDITIONS: Authenticate required artifacts and their exact gate fields before dependent work. Check imports, resource limits and private disk space. Keep missing_file, missing_field and observed zero distinct. Missing external inputs produce terminal blocked evidence with gate_check_summary. Never repin historical evidence to mutable checkout code. Before any load, use cached_current_model(gpu_index=0) to resolve the mandated cached GGUF. Pin file and llama.cpp build hashes. Confirm GPU0 lease, actual CUDA offload, free VRAM and disk. GPU1 belongs to its existing owner. Do not download, rebuild a runtime or use CPU fallback as headline evidence.
3. Before implementation, inspect all callers with rg. Confirm REQ-REPORT-9155-V780 and SCENARIO-REPORT-9155-V780. Extend the specification first. Write failing controls before code. Freeze units, formulas, exclusions and validation scope before outcomes.
4. Bind the Exp9126 frozen tokenization, prefix, caps256/768, full vocabulary and chunk128 protocol. Use only the supported serial forward API. Do not implement embeddings, batching masks or a different tokenizer. Freeze a six-text pilot selected by text-length quantiles from the label-blind roster before model access.
5. Check logits for serial versus chunk128 parity with atol1e-5/rtol1e-4, identical token IDs and correct first-answer alignment. Compare sufficient statistics and raw vector hashes. Test one-token answers, context reset, adjacent chunk boundaries and nonfinite-output refusal. Classify pilot source exposure honestly; never retain pilot answers as new independent evidence.
6. Measure actual load, forward, reduction, serialization, checkpoint and memory/disk costs. Project each of the three300-answer shards from its actual capped token lengths and worst observed per-token rate. Include load and checkpoint overhead. Require each full shard projection<=3300 seconds and available disk>=2GiB raw evidence plus measured storage needs. A watchdog ceiling is not a runtime observation. No row dropping or shorter cap rescues infeasibility.
7. Validate operation-specific current receipts under Exp9154. Emit logit_runtime_ready_score and shard_feasible_score separately. Both require actual model work; all three shard projections must pass. Generated tokens remain0. Block before collection if any whole shard is infeasible; preserve the unchanged total cohort.
8. Run meaningful owned unit tests and actual child-process coverage with 100 percent owned statements and zero exclusions. Preserve original assertions. Run Ruff check/format, strict mypy and explicit-path scripts/check_spec_coverage.py. Execute private real CLI success, refusal, tamper and cold replay outside the checkout without PYTHONPATH, following E2E-018/021. Learning/recovery changes also require E2E-020. Separate unrelated repository health from affected failures. Affected failures disqualify readiness.
9. Stop measurement by 3300 seconds. Reserve 1200 seconds for final verification and300 seconds for publication within the4800-second hard cap. Count each required check once; separate actual elapsed time from its watchdog ceiling. Save unfinished units and censor reasons. Recompute claims from rows. Run scripts/adversarial_verify.py and scripts/verdict_row_consistency_lint.py --strict with heartbeats. Publish only through primary_publication after actual checker receipts pass. Reconcile openspec/, _bmad/traceability.md, ops/status.md and ops/changelog.md. Preserve historical primaries, quarantines and exclusions. Do not activate a roadmap or publish externally.
REQUIRED ARTIFACT FIELDS:
- honest_verdict: complete_*; principle: A terminal prefix records the actual outcome without inducing a spurious retry.
- verdict_class: positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial; principle: Only unfinished owned work uses partial. Absent, retired or blocked external inputs use blocked. Fixtures never establish scientific benefit.
- gate_check_summary: list of check, upstream, path, sha256, artifact_field, op, expected, observed, passed; principle: Every blocked verdict names the failed operand. Missing files and fields are contract failures, distinct from observed zero.
- rows: unit_id, qid/group, sibling, arm/condition, seed, absolute metric, numerator, denominator, status, exclusion_reason and censor_reason; principle: Every comparison can be recomputed at its actual independent unit.
- sample_size_budget: intended, attempted, completed, failed, censored and effective_independent_groups; principle: Siblings, repeated retention and resamples cannot inflate the sample size.
- verifier_is_oracle: boolean; principle: Executable truth reused as the verifier is circular_positive, never an independent verifier win.
- claim_scope: include exposure_scope and independent_generalization_score=0; principle: This exposed human panel cannot close GAP-ORACLE-DISTINCT or GAP-DETECTOR-AUROC-4208. No ARC solve is claimed.
- MODEL_SPECS: actual requested model list with invocation status; principle: Named upstream models cannot masquerade as current inference.
- inference_substrate_class: actual work class plus requested_inference_substrate_class; principle: No-load refusals use blocked_no_run. A failed attempted load is still an attempted load. No artificial duration padding.
- inference_substrate: operation-accurate declaration; principle: Cached reduction, live forward work and generation have different evidentiary costs.
- model_invocation_counts: current_llm_invocations, loads attempted/completed/failed, forward calls and generated_tokens; principle: Current compute counters must agree with operation-specific receipts.
- duration_s: measured wall time; principle: Real process timing bounds throughput claims and detects invented compute.
- random_seed: fixed before measurement; principle: Seeds make the planned comparisons reproducible.
- reproducibility_checksum: input and configuration digest; principle: Changed evidence must not pass as the same experiment.
- source_references: producer path, SHA256 and imported fields; principle: Original evidence authority survives mutable checkout changes.
- code_config_hashes: owned implementation, tests and configuration references; principle: Validation qualifies the exact executed revision.
- current_work_receipts: actual operation-specific receipts; principle: Scripted counters and historical work cannot qualify a current model run.
- validation_receipts: commands, logs, exit status and coverage references; principle: Readiness depends on executed checks, not self-reported success.
- required_checks_passed: boolean; principle: Incomplete or failing affected checks cannot produce readiness.
- acceptance_gates: fixed conditions with one-line principle annotations; principle: Outcome-dependent thresholds cannot manufacture success.
- logit_runtime_ready_score: integer 0/1; principle: Correct supported forwards and actual receipts precede collection.
- shard_feasible_score: integer 0/1; principle: The complete planned populations must fit measured budgets.
- runtime_reference: model/build/tokenizer hashes, prefix and role-blind pilot roster, full-vocabulary parity rows and actual counters; principle: A forward-only canary must be reproducible.
- shard_budget_rows: load, tokens, worst observed rate, overhead, memory, disk and per-shard upper projection; principle: Feasibility includes the whole intended workload.
Run command: cd {project_root} && CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu .venv/bin/python -u scripts/experiments/experiment_9155_v780_logit_runtime.py --date {date}
Do NOT push. Do NOT modify scripts/research_conductor.py.
